jcr:description: Discover the Hoffmann LRF smartHEX Circular External Fixation — a versatile platform featuring connected care, mobile guidance, and advanced software.

largeheadline.line1:
Hoffmann® LRF smartHEX™ 
Circular External Fixation
largeheadline.line2: Bringing the future into the frame

text.text: Hoffmann LRF smartHEX is a platform designed to enhance frame versatility, support patient compliance, and drive connected care through semi-automatic controllers, mobile application guidance, additional components and reimagined software.

text_copy_copy.text: CONTACT US

text_copy.text: Controllers designed for semi-automatic correction

text_708623575_copy.text:
Semi-automatic correction ability via Bluetooth enabled controllers that adjust the struts according to the surgeon’s correction plan.

  • Semi-automatic adjustments: Lithium-ion battery powered controller attaches to support strut adjustments through the correction plan.
  • Compact controller: Modular design helps maintain a streamlined frame profile.

text_copy_copy_copy.text: Additional components and enhanced technology

text_708623575_copy_.text:
Engineered with high-performance materials machined to precise tolerances, Hoffmann LRF smartHEX components are designed to be low profile while supporting enhanced physical access and radiographic visibility without compromising stability.

  • Tabbed rings and fixation: Full, open, and long foot rings offered in both carbon and aluminum. Half-rings and U-plate offered in aluminum, while short foot and foot-arch offered in carbon. Rings marked for intuitive strut attachment.
  • Strut versatility: Mini, extra short, short, medium, and long struts with double telescoping feature to increase length range and minimize strut changeouts.
  • Sensory feedback: Hexapod struts with integrated clicking mechanism for pronounced audible and tactile feedback when controllers are not used.
  • Flexible placement: Offset plates designed to help minimize strut changeouts, provide placement freedom above or below the ring, and allow close ring-to-ring distance.

text_copy_copy.text: Mobile application for connected guidance

text_708623575_copy_.text:
The mobile application helps to keep the correction plan visible and accessible, connecting patient guidance with surgeon oversight throughout treatment. Once connected to the software plan via Bluetooth, the patient will use the mobile app to guide the struts with a simple click of a button.

  • Plan guidance: Mobile app connects to the software plan and guides the controllers through the correction, sending reminders to the patient throughout the treatment.
  • Shared visibility: As the mobile app guides the controllers through the correction plan, the surgeon can see the progress made via the web app. 
  • Remote support: Supports streamlined remote residual correction when needed.
  • Patient compliance: Semi-automatic controllers combined with the mobile app notifications designed to support patient compliance.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Reimagined software for modern correction planning

text_708623575_copy_.text:
The Hoffmann LRF smartHEX web application offers assistance in planning corrections for a range of deformities and complex limb reconstruction procedures.

  • Line tool: Gives surgeons the capability to visualize, analyze, and correct complex deformities.
  • Complete joint angle analysis module: Uses full-length X-rays to support comprehensive joint angle assessment and deformity planning.
  • Enhanced capabilities: Overcorrection, hinge point alignment, and ring-to-ring distance computation abilities.
  • Expanded mounting support: Supports all strut mounting options and offset plates to give surgeons flexibility when planning frame constructs.
  • Non-orthogonal ring support: Enables planning with non-orthogonal ring placement for flexibility in post-op constructs.
  • Single-page cloud-based web app: Designed for speed, scalability, and streamlined access to correction planning tools.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Tailored solutions for diverse frame constructs

text_708623575_copy_.text: A broad set of frame options supports a range of correction needs and construct preferences, enabling the platform to adapt to the clinical objective.

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop: The Hoffmann LRF is a modern circular fixation system designed to reduce construct complexity and simplify application. The typical LRF construct features two or more rings bridged by three to four telescopic struts with multiplanar, ball-jointed fixation bolts. Once applied, the LRF can be unlocked for gross frame adjustment and fracture reduction. The LRF can be finely adjusted to aid in precise limb alignment and definitively locked with secure, advanced locking features. Tight component interfaces may reduce sheer forces and promote construct stability.

1.bullet: • Engineered for greater flexibility to offer more surgical options

2.bullet: • Advanced technology designed for ease of application

3.bullet: • Potential to minimize the number of components for ease of use and light weight

4.bullet: • Carbon Fiber Rings are radiolucent to aid in reduction and healing assessment

5.bullet: • Unique pin clamp design allows for easy application of multiplanar pin fixation

6.bullet: • Mechanically compatible with Hoffmann II and Hoffmann III
